repo.name: Watch Heart
repo.description: The official F-Droid repository for Watch Heart, a diary for every film, series and anime you watch, with monthly Instagram story recaps. Same signed APKs as the GitHub releases.

apps.description:
Watch Heart is a diary for everything you watch: the film on Friday, the series you finish on
Sunday, the anime you swear is the last episode at 1 am. Log it with half stars and a review,
keep a watchlist, and turn each month into an Instagram story.

* Every month a reel of film, every viewing a ticket stub, or a poster wall
* Search films, series and anime in one place, with what's trending this week
* Half-star ratings, hearts, rewatches, seasons and episodes, reviews with spoiler hiding
* Turn any month, or a whole year, into a 1080 × 1920 story: three layouts, six palettes
* A watchlist with "Pick for me" for nights nobody can decide
* Share a link from IMDb, Letterboxd, TMDB or MyAnimeList straight into the app
* Import from Letterboxd, IMDb, Trakt, MyAnimeList, AniList, Netflix, Refract, Serializd and
  TV Time; posters are found automatically
* Works offline; an optional free account backs up and syncs your diary
* Dark Projector or light Paper look, fingerprint App lock, backups and exports
* No ads, no analytics, no tracking

Privacy policy: https://inigo-code.github.io/watch-heart-site/privacy.html

Watch Heart uses TMDB and the TMDB APIs but is not endorsed, certified, or otherwise approved by
TMDB. It isn't affiliated with Letterboxd, IMDb, Trakt, MyAnimeList, AniList, Netflix or the other
apps it imports from.
